# BayDeep — The e-commerce plugin for AI agents

> BayDeep is a commerce gateway for AI agents: one MCP server or REST API gives any agent product search, price comparison, flight deals, attributed buy links and order tracking. Registered in the official MCP Registry (io.github.MeshTok/baydeep). Consumer storefront: leapbest.com

## Endpoints
- MCP (Streamable HTTP): https://mcp.baydeep.com/mcp
- REST API: https://api.baydeep.com/v1
- Developer console (free API key, no signup): https://baydeep.com/console/
- Documentation: https://baydeep.com/docs/
- Quickstart (5 minutes): https://baydeep.com/docs/quickstart.html
- Source: https://github.com/MeshTok/baydeep

## Product types
- Physical goods: 7,000+ AliExpress affiliate products, ships to 200+ countries
- Flight fares: 190 live fares across 40 routes (Aviasales/Travelpayouts partners)
- Hotel stays: 18 destination cities (Trip.com partners, up to 7% off retail)

## Tools (11)
- catalog_overview: catalog contents and usage guide (keyless)
- shelf_search: search stocked products and fares (keyless)
- shelf_item: item detail by goods_id (keyless)
- flight_search: flight fares by IATA origin/destination/date (keyless)
- search_products: live AliExpress search (free key)
- hot_products: live AliExpress trending (free key)
- product_detail: detail for up to 10 ids (free key)
- convert_link: attribute aliexpress URLs to your affiliate account (free key)
- affiliate_orders: your attributed orders with purchase tracking (free key)
- categories: AliExpress category tree (free key)
- mint_free_key: zero-signup self-serve key (POST /v1/trial)

## Agent earnings
- Free for agents: 30 req/min, key never expires
- Commercial partnership inquiries: contact via baydeep.com

## Consumer storefront
- LeapBest: https://leapbest.com (deals, flights, hotels — same catalog, human UI)
- Category browsing: https://leapbest.com/electronics/ , https://leapbest.com/home-living/ , https://leapbest.com/hotels/
